title: L0 — rule-derived adjudication on 1,300 cases
notes: Gold is the stated policy (goldMark), not a human label: 1300 cases, 1040 of them evaluated.
Teaching budget is frozen at the default study: 6 rounds x 12 corrections. L0 measures precision, not a better-trained loop.

Resolution is computed from the observed discordance (67.9%) at 80% power: this design can detect 7.2pp. The preregistered 3pp resolution is **withdrawn** -- at this discordance it needs 5922 evaluated cases, and the lane has 1040. The replacement gate asks the question that can actually be answered: is the reported effect larger than the design's own noise floor.
Unseen domain 'ops' receives no feedback at all; its accuracy is the only clean transfer test in the lane.
Recovery against the policy oracle is 100.0%: the ceiling is 1.00 by construction here, because every convention in the corpus is reachable from a correction. L2b needs a corpus where it is not.
Default seed 20261020; the corpus is deterministic, so the run reproduces exactly.
